reviews_captured_by_me.text:
We've had Bancroft K&B renovate two bathrooms, replace flooring and baseboards, replace kitchen counter tops and fabricate an electric fireplace. We live in a high rise condo with many restrictions. No work before 8.30 AM, out by 5 PM.
Bancroft gave us start dates and always started on time. Upon start, the customer is provided with a production schedule notebook and updates each week. Employees are considerate, talented and clean up after each day. Their subcontractors are also exceptional.
I'm sure you can find numerous contractors that will do the renovations for less, but I don't believe they can provide the quality. I do believe our work was reasonably priced.

From start to finish, Gerald and Haley made our kitchen update a success!! Their professionalism and expert advice guided us through materials and color selection of quartz countertops and tile backsplash. Gerald's visits to our home to measure, advise, provide suggestions and samples convinced us that Bancroft would be a company we could trust to do the job well. The countertop and tile installers did a great job, were pleasant to work with and left our kitchen clean and tidy as they completed their jobs! We love our updated kitchen and without hesitation will recommend Bancroft to others!

Bancroft saved the day on my kitchen remodel in the OBX.  They had everything I needed and went above and beyond to get my kitchen job completed in time for the arrival of my first renters.  Gerald and Haley were so wonderful to work with and kept me updated with photos and texts the whole time.  My family has used Bancroft on 3local and 2 OBX jobs and they’ve never let us down.  We now have beautiful kitchens and highly recommend them to all.
